name: dnbelab_c4
description: DNBelab C4 / DNBelab C Series 3' single-cell RNA-seq data recognized from metadata and FASTQ structure. Automatic mapping is intentionally halted until DNBelab/PISA-compatible preprocessing resources are supplied.
notes: Do not infer from product-family wording alone. Use this profile when metadata indicates DNBelab C4/C Series/PISA/DNBSEQ/DIPSEQ and FASTQ evidence shows a DNBelab-like barcode/UMI read plus a long cDNA read. Public FASTQs can require DNBelab/PISA-specific barcode correction and preprocessing; UniScFlow therefore routes this platform to download + halt by default rather than generating STARsolo commands directly.

halt_guidance.blocker: DNBelab C Series reads require chemistry-matched barcode parsing/correction and PISA/DNBelab preprocessing before a STAR-compatible cDNA stream can be trusted.
required_inputs: DNBelab C Series kit version and barcode structure/whitelist
PISA or DNBelab analysis configuration and a matching reference
next_steps: Confirm the exact DNBelab C Series chemistry from the experiment documentation.
Run PISA/DNBelab preprocessing with the matching barcode configuration.
Use the vendor-generated matrix, or explicitly validate corrected barcode/cDNA streams before any STARsolo analysis.

recommended_workflows.name: DNBelab C Series scRNA analysis software

halt_guidance.resume: A STARsolo workflow is appropriate only after vendor-compatible barcode correction has produced validated inputs; the standard UniScFlow route remains halted.
